scopes.name: app
scopes.store: proxy/appparts.py (the page's switches in the config database)

scopes.name: auth
scopes.store: the config database's settings auth.<key> (proxy/settingscopes.py AuthScope), with TANDEM_AUTH=accounts only: the identity provider, local mode, the sign-in form, who may chat, the session timeouts, the password length; owner-only writes, never with an API token, the provider after the owner's password

scopes.name: api
scopes.store: the config database's settings api.<key> (proxy/settingscopes.py ApiScope), with TANDEM_AUTH=accounts only: each protocol's exposure switch, the listen address (TANDEM_HOST in the env file, at the next restart), the token rules; owner-only writes but tokens.viewers_may_create (an admin's), never with an API token, the exposure and the listen address after the owner's password

scopes.name: backends
scopes.store: the config database: backends, routing rules, users (proxy/config.py)

scopes.name: engine
scopes.store: each paired engine host's managed overlay through tandem remote settings (engine-ctl-v1), versioned; hot keys through PATCH /v1/engine/settings (engine API 1.9); its mode (the keys mode and mode.ext) through tandem remote mode set, after the chat extension is installed when it is missing
scopes.targets: an engine host's fleet id (ssh), or http:<backend id> read-only

scopes.name: hooks
scopes.store: the hook registry's and the decision providers' tables (proxy/hookstore.py, proxy/providerstore.py) through their adapter (proxy/hooksettings.py): each hook's and each provider's switches, a provider's API keys write-only; the full payload is granted with pairing's rights, outside the LAN with a second confirm

scopes.name: plugins
scopes.store: the plugin registry's tables (proxy/pluginstore.py) through the plugins scope (proxy/pluginsettings.py): one target a plugin, its keys from its manifest: enabled, settings.<property> from its settings schema, secrets.<NAME> write-only, capabilities.<capability> (deny by default), trust (sandboxed or host, for a manifest that asks host); enabling and every grant take pairing's rights, prompts:full, engine:control, network outside the LAN and trust host a second confirm
